candidate_name: Eddystone LNG export terminal (Delaware County, PA)
sponsor_or_proposer: Franc James / 'Eddystone Energy LLC' (DE-registered; successor concept to the now-shelved Penn LNG / Penn America Energy)
current_state: Early concept/relocation of the dissolved Penn LNG proposal to a new Delaware River site in Eddystone, PA. Community controversy reported May 2026; no FERC/DOE filing, no permits, no feedgas, no FID, no firm capacity disclosed.
missing_threshold_elements: No concrete regulatory step (no FERC pre-filing/application); only a proposer + approximate location. Below GEM 'sufficient information to add' bar.
watch_for: FERC pre-filing or DOE export application under Eddystone Energy LLC; DRBC/PA DEP filings; a disclosed capacity/site footprint. If filed, evaluate whether it's a new terminal vs. a relocation of the existing Penn LNG record.
notes: Likely the same backers as Penn LNG (GEM T100000131080, shelved 2026), simply relocated ~1 town over. Do not create a duplicate record; treat as a watch on the Penn LNG cluster.
